records.body:

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero customer replies to the welcome email (email:ddc75c28), no project, no invite, no tickets. No signal of intent or engagement; only 8 days left. Unaided activation on Starter with a silent admin is unlikely.

draft.subject: Quick hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Checking in now that you've had Wrenfield for a few days. If getting started has been on the back burner, that's easy to fix: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually enough to make the rest click.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up along the way.

Best,
Nadia
